new_conventions_for_owner.decision: Open (gapped) 180 deg hems count as 1 line on the outer crown, built with the D0 tangent-band construction, exactly like the closed hem of D0 gb_44b168.

On a fold interrupted by windows so large that the fold exists only at short rungs, the gold keeps the tool's envelope apex (the outermost material, mostly rail-edge corners between rungs) instead of the rung arc apex. Measured offset from the rung arc apex: 0.85 mm (b3ae40), 0.93-1.25 mm (b97c8e).

Formed-fold test for short or ambiguous pieces: if the outer material at the bisector sits closer to the plane sharp than any formed fold of that thickness allows ((sqrt2 - 1) * t for 90 deg, i.e. Ri = 0), at every station, the junction is a sharp/abutting corner and not a bend; if it sits at the expected formed-apex offset over >= 80 % of the line, it is a formed fold.
The adjudicator added the patch-9 end hem of gb_68cd06 (MISSING_ADD) on its own raw-scan sections, with no third marking. Neither marker drew it; marker A noted the overlap but called it unclear.
